title: Monitoring and Logging
summary: We monitor request rate, latency, errors, CPU/memory, and connection pools using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and Jaeger.

content.overview: We implement observability by collecting metrics, logs, and traces from production systems to detect and diagnose issues.
content.details: Metrics we track: request rate and latency, error rates, CPU and memory usage, database connection pool stats. Tools: Prometheus for metrics collection, Grafana for visualization, ELK stack for centralized logging, Jaeger for distributed tracing.
